headline: No United hub has a program now; San Francisco may get one.

items.text: No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub. The FAA's operations plan says a ground delay program is possible for flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 9:00 PM PT; it is not in effect.
A ground delay program is in effect for flights into Boston (BOS) until 12:30 AM ET because of heavy traffic, with delays averaging 41 minutes and up to 96 minutes.
The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET. It is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Boston, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
